# Architecture Specialist Skill

## Goals

- Build a design that is traceable to requirements.
- Make integration points and failure paths explicit.
- Prepare the design for review without hidden assumptions.

## Checklist

- Map each major component to a requirement.
- Document data flow and dependency boundaries.
- Record risks, tradeoffs, and rejected options.
- Flag unresolved decisions for review.
